sections_target.text: Maintenance Steps to be Carried Out

rows: Clean the cell with an air blower.
Disconnect terminals (2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11) from the relay at the back.
Connect the Severker 650 injection test set leads to points (2, 3) on the relay at the back for phase R.

Connect the Stop leads from the Severker 650 injection test set to terminals (4, 5) on the relay at the back (note: connect point 5 to the positive point, red in colour, on the Severker 650 injection test set, and connect point 4 to the negative point, blue in colour, on the Severker 650 injection test set, without disconnecting terminals (4, 5) on the relay at the back).
Set the injection current value to (2 x Setting Value).
Switch off the Severker 650 injection test set.
Set the selector on the Severker 650 injection test set to the N.O. Contact position.
Reset the time meter display on the Severker 650 injection test set.
Set the Severker 650 injection test set operating switch to the (ON Time) position.

Record the relay operating time value corresponding to a current of (2 x Setting Value) for phase R (note that the Severker 650 injection test set switches off automatically after the relay operates).
Reduce the current to zero, then switch off the Severker 650 injection test set.
Connect the Severker 650 injection test set leads to points (6, 7) on the relay at the back for phase S.

Connect the Stop leads from the Severker 650 injection test set to terminals (7, 6) on the relay at the back for phase S (note: connect point 5 to the positive point, red in colour, on the Severker 650 injection test set, and connect point 4 to the negative point, blue in colour, on the Severker 650 injection test set, without disconnecting terminals (4, 5) on the relay at the back).
Set the injection current value to (2 x Setting Value).
Switch off the Severker 650 injection test set.
Set the selector on the Severker 650 injection test set to the N.O. Contact position.
Reset the time meter display on the Severker 650 injection test set.
Set the Severker 650 injection test set operating switch to the (ON Time) position.

Record the relay operating time value corresponding to a current of (2 x Setting Value) for phase T (note that the Severker 650 injection test set switches off automatically after the relay operates).
Reduce the current to zero, then switch off the Severker 650 injection test set.
Connect the Severker 650 injection test set leads to points (10, 11) on the relay at the back for phase T.

Connect the Stop leads from the Severker 650 injection test set to terminals (4, 5) on the relay at the back (note: connect point 5 to the positive point, red in colour, on the Severker 650 injection test set, and connect point 4 to the negative point, blue in colour, on the Severker 650 injection test set, without disconnecting terminals (4, 5) on the relay at the back).
Set the injection current value to (2 x Setting Value).
Switch off the Severker 650 injection test set.
Set the selector on the Severker 650 injection test set to the N.O. Contact position.
Reset the time meter display on the Severker 650 injection test set.
Set the Severker 650 injection test set operating switch to the (ON Time) position.

Record the relay operating time value corresponding to a current of (2 x Setting Value) for phase T (note that the Severker 650 injection test set switches off automatically after the relay operates).
Reduce the current to zero, then switch off the Severker 650 injection test set.
Reconnect terminals (2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11) on the relay at the back.
Remove the plastic cover from the relay at the front.
Reset the relay.
Refit the plastic cover on the relay at the front.
Reset the lock-out relay on the cell, confirming this by hearing the sound of the relay and by the CB Trip indication lamp going out.
